subject: general
question: In March 2026, the Ministry of Defence signed a ₹413 crore contract with Boeing India for the 'Depot Level Maintenance' of which maritime reconnaissance aircraft?
solution:
The correct answer is __**P8I.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Ministry of Defence (MoD) signed two contracts worth ₹858 crore on March 27, 2026, including one for the maintenance of the P8I fleet.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The contract for P8I aircraft inspection and maintenance is valued at ₹413 crore and was signed with Boeing India Defense Private Ltd.**
 
• It falls under the **'Buy Indian'** category with **100% Indigenous Content**, supporting the Aatmanirbhar Bharat initiative.
 
• The maintenance will be carried out at an **in-country MRO** (Maintenance, Repair, and Overhaul) facility.
 
• **Tunguska Air Defence Missile System__**

 Contract Value: ₹445 crore.

 Partner: Signed with JSC Rosoboronexport, Russia.

 Capability: These systems will protect the Indian Army against aerial threats, including drones, aircraft, and cruise missiles, reinforcing the Indo-Russian strategic partnership.
 
• __P8I Aircraft__
 __
 
• Role - Long-range maritime reconnaissance and Anti-Submarine Warfare (ASW).
 
• Manufacturer - Boeing (USA).
 
• Service - Indian Navy.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Tunguska Air Defence System__

 __
 
• Contract - ₹445 crore signed with JSC Rosoboronexport, Russia.
 
• Purpose - Protection of the Indian Army against drones, aircraft, and cruise missiles.
 
 
 
• MRO Facility__
 
 
• Definition - Maintenance, Repair, and Overhaul facilities are essential for keeping military and civil aircraft airworthy without sending them abroad.
 
 

24c:T1
